resampling: Sample twelve actual-arrival seed blocks with replacement, preserving all eight catalogue/load cells and both policies in each block.
aggregation: Equal-tape restricted mean and pair-common-completed-ID P90; ratio of aggregate means. Unfinished jobs use total count difference only.
interval: Pointwise percentile 95%, linear interpolation at 0.025 and 0.975; no multiplicity adjustment or replacement of original gates.
scope: Post-confirmation descriptive uncertainty on all existing confirmation tapes, conditional on fixed planning streams; no new trajectories or independent confirmation. No outcome-based omission of cells or seeds.
